title: Tanzania's Southern Circuit: Ruaha, Nyerere and Mikumi
excerpt: Ruaha, Nyerere and Mikumi form Tanzania's southern circuit: wilder, quieter and with different safari activities.
body:
Southern Tanzania is much less visited than the north. Its parks are large, wild and quiet, with activities such as boat and walking safaris.

## The parks

- **[Nyerere National Park](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/)** (formerly part of the Selous Game Reserve): rivers and lakes, boat safaris.
- **[Ruaha National Park](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/):** big, rugged and known for large lion prides.
- **[Mikumi National Park](/blog/mikumi-national-park-guide/):** accessible from Dar es Salaam.
- **[Udzungwa Mountains](/blog/udzungwa-mountains-hiking/):** rainforest hiking.

## Why the south

- Very few vehicles.
- Boat safaris, walking safaris and in some places night drives.
- Wild dogs: some of the best chances in Tanzania.

## Getting there

Usually by light aircraft from Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar. By road it is possible but long.

## When

The dry season, roughly June to October, is the best time. Some camps close in the long rains.

## Combine

The south combines well with Zanzibar or the north. See our [10-day southern safari](/itineraries/10-days-safari-mikumi-udzungwa-ruaha-nyerere/).
